description: Start here: what this is, how to read it, and where to look next.

options.content:
# Welcome to noise is bad.

A Grafana panel for the office television that answers one question from across the room: **how bad are things
right now?** The screen represents attention, not infrastructure. Nothing healthy is ever drawn, so the screen
gets noisier only as more things break, and you can tell how bad it is without reading a word.

This is real Grafana, and nothing you do here is saved. Look around: open any dashboard below, and use a panel's
menu (**⋮**, top right of the panel) → **Inspect** to see its query, its data and every setting.

panels.title: Live: a shipping incident, on an 84-second loop

options.content:
### How to read it

- **Quiet:** nothing is wrong. A screensaver drifts around.
- **One box:** one problem, and it takes the whole screen.
- **More boxes:** the worst problem gets the most room.
- **Brighter and bigger:** it has been going on for longer.

### Look around

- **[Watch it break](d/a538aeff-5a8a-42a5-901c-938d896fdd6f)**: the incident on the left, full size.
- **[No issues](d/noise-is-bad-quiet)**: every screensaver, side by side.
- **[Real data](d/noise-is-bad-prometheus)**: the same panel reading Prometheus.
- **[Sloth](d/noise-is-bad-sloth)**: Sloth's recording rules, untouched.
- **[Transitions](d/noise-is-bad-transitions)**: how boxes arrive and leave.
